description:
Software purpose-built for planning and building teams. All the tools you need to assess, compare, annotate and approve digital plans.


Changes
- Changed PDF compression to always keep scale information
- Changed PDF compression to keep bookmarks by default
Fixes
- Fixed a memory issue when creating a callout with empty text
- Fixed a memory issue when creating a sticky note with text from the annotation panel
- Fixed a potential memory issue with the quick measurement warning dialog
- Fixed incorrect XML date/time parsing when the date/time contains fractional seconds
- Fixed license server connection failure message sometimes showing the wrong day
